### `access.alt_text` — Alt-Text Author

Writes concise, purposeful alternative text for images, using vision when an image is supplied.

**Why it exists.** Most images on the web ship without alt text because writing it is nobody's job.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `transform` — Replaces the component's text in place; a provenance badge allows reverting. |
| Binds to | `Image` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | string | no |
| `context` | string | no |
| `filename` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `alt` | string |
| `decorative` | boolean |
| `confidence` | number |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.image("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'/>").ai("access.alt_text")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("access.alt_text", {"filename": "team-offsite-2026.jpg", "context": "About us page"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "alt": "Team offsite 2026",
  "decorative": false,
  "confidence": 0.35
}
```

### `access.label_audit` — Accessible Name Synthesis

Finds controls without an accessible name and proposes one for each.

**Why it exists.** An unlabeled control is invisible to assistive technology; fixing it should be one click.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `audit` — A findings list with severities; selecting a finding highlights its target. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `fields` | list of object {name, value, confidence} |
| `notes` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("access.label_audit")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("access.label_audit", {"scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Search"}, "children": [{"type": "Input", "id": "q", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}, {"type": "Button", "id": "go", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "q",
      "value": "Search orders",
      "confidence": 0.8
    },
    {
      "name": "go",
      "value": "Search",
      "confidence": 0.85
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Proposed names for unlabeled controls."
}
```

### `access.plain_language` — Plain-Language Mode

Rewrites interface copy in plain language: common words, short sentences, active voice.

**Why it exists.** Plain language is an accessibility requirement and a conversion tactic at once.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `transform` — Replaces the component's text in place; a provenance badge allows reverting. |
| Binds to | `Text`, `Markdown`, `Callout`, `Banner` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | string |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("access.plain_language")

# or call it from a handler

```

```json
  "rationale": "Replaced formal vocabulary and shortened sentences."
```

### `access.narrate` — Screen Narration

Produces a short spoken-style orientation of a screen: what it is, what it contains, what to do first.

**Why it exists.** Screen-reader users hear a page linearly; a ten-second overview restores the glance sighted users get.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `media` — Produces or consumes audio and images. |
| Binds to | `Page` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | string |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.page("Quarterly review").ai("access.narrate")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("access.narrate", {"scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Invoices"}, "children": [{"type": "Table", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}, {"type": "Button", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "text": "Invoices. It has 1 table, 1 action. The main action is “New invoice”.",
  "rationale": "Orientation first, then structure, then the main action."
}
```

### `access.focus_order` — Focus Order Reasoner

Computes a logical keyboard focus order: dialogs first, reading order next, primary action last in its group.

**Why it exists.** Tab order silently breaks whenever layout changes; it should be derived, not maintained.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | list of object {label, detail, value, action, icon, score} |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("access.focus_order", {"scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "T"}, "children": [{"type": "Input", "id": "a", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}, {"type": "Button", "id": "b", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "label": "A",
      "detail": "Input",
      "value": "a",
      "action": null,
      "icon": null,
      "score": 1.0
    },
    {
      "label": "Go",
      "detail": "Button",
      "value": "b",
      "action": null,

      "score": 2.0

}
```

### `access.linearize` — Step-by-Step Linearizer

**Why it exists.** Cognitive accessibility often means the same content, one decision at a time.

| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | balanced |
| Surface | `compose` — Renders the returned scene inside the component. |
| Binds to | `Generative` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

| `rationale` | string |

### `access.captions` — Live Captions

**Why it exists.** Raw transcripts are technically captions and practically unreadable.

| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |

| Field | Type | Required |

**Output**

| --- | --- |
| `lines` | list of string |

**Use it**


### `access.audit` — Accessibility Audit

Audits a scene against WCAG 2.2 success criteria and proposes a fix for every finding.

**Why it exists.** Accessibility regressions are cheapest to catch before a screen ships.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | hybrid: the engine computes the facts, the model writes the narrative |
| Model tier | balanced |
| Surface | `audit` — A findings list with severities; selecting a finding highlights its target. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `score` | number |
| `summary` | string |
| `findings` | list of object {id, severity, title, detail, target, fix} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("access.audit")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("access.audit", {"scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Gallery"}, "children": [{"type": "Image", "props": {"…": "1 keys"}}, {"type": "Link", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "score": 82.0,
  "summary": "2 accessibility findings: 1 blocking, 1 to improve.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "a11y.1.1.1",
      "severity": "error",
      "title": "Image without alternative text",
      "detail": "Screen readers announce nothing for this image.",
      "target": "_r.0",
      "fix": "Describe the image, or set an empty alt if it is decorative."
    },
    {
      "id": "a11y.2.4.4",
      "severity": "warning",
      "title": "Link text is not descriptive",
      "detail": "“click here” means nothing out of context.",
      "target": "_r.1",
      "fix": "Describe the destination in the link text."
    }
  ]
}
```

### `access.readability` — Readability Restructure

Reformats dense paragraphs into short, scannable lines suited to readers with dyslexia or attention differences.

**Why it exists.** Walls of text exclude more people than low contrast does.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `transform` — Replaces the component's text in place; a provenance badge allows reverting. |
| Binds to | `Text`, `Markdown` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | string |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("access.readability")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("access.readability", {"text": "Your subscription renews automatically on the first of each month, and you can cancel at any time from the billing page, which also lists…"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "text": "• Your subscription renews automatically on the first of each month.\n• You can cancel at any time from the billing page.\n• Also lists pas…",
  "rationale": "One idea per line, short sentences, no dense paragraphs."
}
```

### `access.motion` — Motion Sensitivity Advisor

Finds continuous or large motion in a scene and specifies calmer equivalents for reduced-motion users.

**Why it exists.** Vestibular disorders make some animation physically unpleasant; alternatives must be designed, not just disabled.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `state` | string |
| `confidence` | number |
| `directives` | list of object {kind, target, value, reason} |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("access.motion", {"scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Loading"}, "children": [{"type": "Skeleton", "id": "sk"}, {"type": "Progress", "id": "p", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "state": "reduce",
  "confidence": 0.8,
  "directives": [
    {
      "kind": "reduce_motion",
      "target": "sk",
      "value": "static",
      "reason": "Skeleton animates continuously."
    },
    {
      "kind": "reduce_motion",
      "target": "p",
      "value": "static",
      "reason": "Progress animates continuously."
    }
  ]
}
```

### `access.describe_chart` — Chart Description

Writes the text alternative for a chart: its type, range, extremes and trend, computed from the data.

**Why it exists.** A chart without a description is a blank rectangle to a screen reader.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | hybrid: the engine computes the facts, the model writes the narrative |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `annotate` — An insight panel attached to the component, with confidence and provenance. |
| Binds to | `Chart` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | list of any | yes |
| `kind` | string | no |
| `x` | string | no |
| `y` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | string |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.chart("bar").ai("access.describe_chart")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("access.describe_chart", {"kind": "line", "data": [{"m": "Jan", "v": 10}, {"m": "Feb", "v": 14}, {"m": "Mar", "v": 19}], "x": "m", "y": "v"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "text": "Line chart of v by m with 3 points, from 10 to 19. Highest 19 at Mar; lowest 10 at Jan. Overall trend: up.",
  "rationale": "Structure, range, extremes and trend — the same reading order as a sighted glance."
}
```
